selection.rule: the only R105 basis clearing all predeclared anchor-component, cosine and quantized-nonzero thresholds; early and middle bases remain rejected

reconstruction.r107_reconstruction_source: re-run the exact hash-bound R105 public-limit locally relevant projection for anchor-offset-11
reconstruction.variable_scope: root XYZ plus V9 selected bilateral ten leg DoFs
reconstruction.immutable_scope: complete-clip frames outside 240..249, root quaternion, root yaw velocity, all non-selected joint positions, contacts, contact modes and source contact points
reconstruction.controller_semantics: candidate reference joint positions are the fixed-PD targets; no separate control-target array, desired velocity, feed-forward, controller, limit or reset change
reconstruction.projection_objective: minimum normalized Euclidean distance from the late R103 basis under the locally relevant V9 SQP Jacobian rows with public limits and zero internal solver margins
reconstruction.projection_solution_identity: R107 must reproduce R105 anchor component 9722 bp, cosine 9872 bp, 45 nonzero quantized joint cells, maximum 5688 urad joint correction and 41 um root correction before exact audit

quantization.root_rule: multiply projected root increments by 1000000, ties-to-even round to micrometres, then add to V9 root_position_um only at frames 240..249
quantization.joint_rule: multiply projected selected-leg increments by 1000000, ties-to-even round to microradians, then add by descriptor dof_ordinal to V9 joint_position_urad only at frames 240..249
dependent_recomputation: root_linear_velocity_um_s from the frozen hybrid stencil
joint_velocity_urad_s from the frozen hybrid stencil

future_exact_offline_audit.candidate_artifact_policy: construct in memory only; emit exact metrics report, not artifact
required_checks: R105 late projection identity reproduces before quantization
root/joint position inputs at frames 238 and 239 and every frame outside 240..249 remain exact V9
frame-238 root/joint position and emitted velocity remain exact V9; other dependent values may change only through the declared stencil, FK and CoM recomputation
all non-dependent arrays remain byte-exact V9
source contact modes and every source contact point remain frozen
exact contact residual and finite/analytic contact velocity bounds
all collider samples and stable foot-box vertices
frozen selected-leg ROM and root/joint velocity bounds

failure_disposition.r107_exact_failure: select progressive KTO then inverse-dynamics then kinodynamic formulation; do not shrink, scale, repair or sweep the late direction
